signal: Wavetronix has grown to about 305 employees and its mobile traffic lab took its first international trip, signaling expansion of its smart-city radar sensor business.

email.body1:
Dan, saw Wavetronix taking its mobile traffic lab international for the first time as the smart-city radar business expands.

Expansion into new regions usually means more agencies and integrators in play than a regional team can cover before quota resets. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Wavetronix off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Dan, quick follow-up for Wavetronix.

As territory expands, most regional teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to cover the new ground. The gap shows up late in the quarter, and by then it's a scramble to recover rather than a plan to hit the number.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Dan, last bit of proof for Wavetronix.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your region's reply rate likely compares to peer infrastructure teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Dan, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling regional coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Expansion has its own rhythm, and timing matters more than any pitch.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of 3 AI-SDR plays scoped to a regional motion? I'll tailor it to Wavetronix either way.
